invariants.description: A run, checkpoint, memory record, artifact, and trace must remain scoped to its authenticated tenant and project.
Narrative output cannot override artifact existence, KiCad validation, routing, ERC, DRC, or independent-review evidence.
KiCad symbols, footprints, pin-pad compatibility, tool results, and manufacturing artifacts must be grounded in actual files or tool output.
A repair cannot silently remove or weaken an accepted user hard constraint in order to pass a grader.
A run is pinned to one harness, policy, profile, model-policy, and toolchain identity for its complete lifetime.
A patch-producing agent cannot read or modify sealed holdout cases, adversarial graders, or release-policy decisions.
An evolution candidate may create evidence and a draft patch, but production promotion requires an authenticated approval and a reversible rollout.
